messages:
Vera: Quick note  ran a compact onboarding for Lodestar12b int6 vs int6b vs fp16. Posting top-level: int6 ~2.6x token-cost reduction, int6b ~2.25x. Overall macro accuracy deltas: int6 -1.5%, int6b -0.8%.

Diego: Which slices are risky?

Vera: Short human-reviewed hits:
- product-name-ner: int6 -4.3%, int6b -2.0%
- multi-turn-longform: int6 -1.1%, int6b -0.5%
- code-formatting: neutral
Locale skew: ja/de higher on small samples.

Nina: Cost sketch per 10k reqs (avg 3.3k toks/req): fp16 baseline ~$396/day, full int6 ~$152/day => ~$244/day saved. If we add fp16 rescoring for 12% requests net ~198/day.

Harper (prod): Product constraint: we can't accept >3% drop on product-name routes. What's pragmatic?

Diego: Two pragmatic mitigations: (A) Default int6b with per-route holdbacks for NER-sensitive routes, (B) Default int6 but hybrid routing: pin NER routes to fp16 + async fp16 rescoring for snippets when confidence <0.6.

Vera: Rollout proposal:
- Phase 0: 48h shadow logging for locale-sliced signals
- Phase 1: 1% live with hybrid routing + async rescoring (12%)
- Phase 2: 5% live + start int6b A/B on a subset
- Phase 3: 20% if no regressions; auto-rollback on >2.0% absolute NER precision drop over 2 consecutive 1h buckets.

Harper (prod): OK. Also request locale holdbacks for ja/de initially. PMs want 3 anonymized before/after examples.

Nina: Eng effort: routing flags + per-route locale tag ~2 dev-days, async rescoring pipeline reuse ~3 dev-days, telemetry + alerts ~1 SRE-day.

R&D-bot: Artifact uploaded lodestar12b-int6b sha:c0ffee at 3329990012

Vera: Action items: Nina produce cost sensitivity table (cache 20/50/80%), Diego add routing-flag PR, Harper collect anonymized examples, I'll own rollout doc and gate thresholds. Revisit after 48h shadow.
